levels.title: Module 8 Level 1
levels.task: Use a CTE to select pop songs and return all columns.
levels.solution: WITH pop_songs AS (SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE genre = 'Pop') SELECT * FROM pop_songs;
levels.hintMessage: Define a CTE with WITH and select from it.

levels.title: Module 8 Level 2
levels.task: Use a CTE to count performances per venue, then show venue names and counts.
levels.solution: WITH perf_counts AS (SELECT venue_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM festival_performances GROUP BY venue_id) SELECT v.name, p.cnt FROM perf_counts p JOIN venues v ON p.venue_id = v.id;
levels.hintMessage: Build counts in a CTE, then join to venues.

levels.title: Module 8 Level 3
levels.task: Use two CTEs to return artists who have songs and performances (by name match).
levels.solution: WITH song_artists AS (SELECT DISTINCT artist_name FROM top_songs), perf_artists AS (SELECT DISTINCT artist_name FROM festival_performances) SELECT s.artist_name FROM song_artists s JOIN perf_artists p ON s.artist_name = p.artist_name;
levels.hintMessage: Create one CTE per source and join them.

levels.title: Module 8 Level 4
levels.task: Use a CTE to return high-capacity venues (> 3000).
levels.solution: WITH big_venues AS (SELECT * FROM venues WHERE capacity > 3000) SELECT * FROM big_venues;
levels.hintMessage: Filter inside the CTE, then select from it.

levels.title: Module 8 Level 5
levels.task: Use a CTE to sort top_songs by weeks_on_chart descending and return title + weeks.
levels.solution: WITH ranked_songs AS (SELECT track_name, weeks_on_chart FROM top_songs ORDER BY weeks_on_chart DESC) SELECT * FROM ranked_songs;
levels.hintMessage: Put the ordered projection in the CTE.
